items.title: Investigating degraded experiences across GitHub products
items.summary: The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.

items.title: Some customers cannot create monitors
items.summary: We’re investigating an issue that prevents some customers from creating monitors in the Cloudflare dashboard under Alerts → Monitors. Affected customers may see error 17204 stating that their account has a limit of zero custom analytics policies. We’ll share an update as we learn more.

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 Path Traversal via Minecraft Server Playtime Limits
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a path traversal vulnerability in minecraft/minecraft-lib.pl that allows unauthenticated game players to overwrite arbitrary files as root via crafted chat messages. Attackers can send chat messages mimicking logged in lines so the root check playtime limits cron job rewrites attacker-chosen files, destroying their contents.

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 Missing IMAP Certificate Validation in imap login
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in imap login in mailboxes/folders-lib.pl that skips certificate verification and hostname checks for IMAP SSL connections. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to capture IMAP credentials sent by the System and Server Status IMAP monitor and spoof monitor results.

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 OS Command Injection via ldap-client/check.cgi
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in ldap-client/check.cgi that allows LDAP directory writers to execute commands via unquoted uid values. Attackers can create a posixAccount entry with shell metacharacters in its uid, executing commands as root when an administrator runs Check Configuration.

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 Stored XSS via LDAP Samba Attributes in edit user.cgi
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/edit user.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup through the LDAP sambaAcctFlags and sambaBadPasswordCount attributes, which are rendered without HTML encoding. Attackers with LDAP write access to these attributes can store malicious scripts that execute in a Webmin administrator's browser when the user entry is opened…

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 Improper Certificate Validation in switch smtp to ssl
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in switch smtp to ssl in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl and status/smtp-monitor.pl, which calls Net::SSLeay::connect without certificate verification or a hostname check. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate when SMTP with SSL or STARTTLS is configured to capture SMTP AUTH credentials and message content.

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 XSS via status/edit mon.cgi Monitor Descriptions
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in status/edit mon.cgi that allows attackers to inject scripts through unescaped monitor status descriptions. Malicious HTTP or FTPS server operators, on-path attackers, or local users creating crafted filenames in wildcard-monitored directories can execute JavaScript in a Webmin user's session.

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 Stored XSS via Cluster Modules
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject scripts by supplying values from managed hosts that cluster modules render unescaped. Attackers who can edit a Servers Index description, control a managed host, or intercept its RPC link can inject server descriptions, versions, user/group names, or package fields to execute JavaScript in the central…

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 XSS via software/rpmfind.cgi and man/search.cgi
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows on-path network attackers to inject script by tampering with plaintext HTTP search results rendered unescaped. Attackers who intercept rpmfind.net or Google responses can inject autofocus/onfocus payloads that execute in a logged-in user's browser within the Webmin origin.

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 GnuPG Signature Check Bypass in Module Updates
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a signature verification bypass vulnerability in webmin-lib.pl that allows attackers to install unsigned module updates when GnuPG setup fails. Attackers tampering with update downloads via network position or a custom update URL can supply malicious modules that run as root when administrators apply updates.

items.title: Webmin through 2.670 Improper TLS Certificate Validation via http download
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the http download function of web-lib-funcs.pl that skips TLS chain and hostname verification. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate and substitute downloaded modules, themes, or catalog content, leading to root code execution or injected HTML.

items.title: CVE-2026-80288
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Input Validation vulnerability. An attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information and privileged functionality.

items.summary: A flaw was found in the Admin REST API v2 of Keycloak. This component is used by administrators to manage realm configurations, including clients. The issue occurs because the API processes a client update (PUT) request and performs payload validation before verifying if the caller has the required permissions to view or manage that specific client. By sending a request with a mismatched client ID in the body, an…

items.title: soapbar: verify envelope bsp accepts an unauthenticated embedded certificate (signature forgery / authentication bypass)

It read the X.509 certificate out of the caller-untrusted wsse:BinarySecurityToken , validated only that certificate's not-before / not-after dates, and then verified the signature against that same certificate. There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. A successful verify envelope bsp()…

items.title: TwigView FileLoader may allow arbitrary file reads through user-controlled template paths
items.summary: Impact If FileLoader::findTemplate() is supplied un-validated user controlled data, arbitrary files can be read. Patches 1.3.3 and 2.1.2 contain a fix for this issue. Workarounds Don't supply user controlled data to include and extends tags.

items.title: github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp permits denial of service through a malformed IPv4 payload length
items.summary: In github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp/dhcpv4/nclient4, BroadcastRawUDPConn.ReadFrom does not validate that the IPv4 payload length is sufficient to hold a UDP header before calculating the DHCP payload length. A frame with an IPv4 total-length field specifying fewer than eight payload bytes results in a negative DHCP length, causing a panic in buf.Consume due to a negative slice bound.

items.title: etcd: CRL enforcement bypass on gRPC listener when --listen-client-http-urls is configured

When etcd is configured with --listen-client-http-urls to split the HTTP and gRPC client endpoints onto separate listeners, the --client-crl-file Certificate Revocation List is not enforced on the gRPC listener. A client presenting a revoked certificate is correctly rejected by the HTTP endpoint but continues to authenticate successfully over gRPC. Patches…

items.title: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

items.title: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.summary: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

items.title: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
items.summary: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

items.title: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

items.title: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
items.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

items.title: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

items.title: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.summary: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.
